name: learn-postman
description: Learn, automate, and scale API testing with Postman, AI agents, and reusable workflows.

scripts.test:fr01: newman run postman/collections/fr01/collection.json -e postman/environments/local.json --iteration-data postman/collections/fr01/data-domain.csv --reporters cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export postman/reports/fr01-report.html --reporter-json-export docs/apis/post-register/newman-summary.json
scripts.test:fr07: newman run postman/collections/fr07/collection.json -e postman/environments/local.json --iteration-data postman/collections/fr07/data-domain.csv --reporters cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export postman/reports/fr07-report.html --reporter-json-export docs/apis/post-cart/newman-summary.json
scripts.test:fr17: newman run postman/collections/fr17/collection.json -e postman/environments/local.json --iteration-data postman/collections/fr17/data-domain.csv --reporters cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export postman/reports/fr17-report.html --reporter-json-export docs/apis/post-admin-coupons/newman-summary.json
scripts.test:all: npm run test:fr01 && npm run test:fr07 && npm run test:fr17
